evals.prompt:
Render a complete Diátaxis documentation set from the sample session findings corpus.

Run:

  OUTDIR=$(pwd)
  $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/packs/channels/diataxis/scripts/render-diataxis.sh "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/reports/_meta/sample-session/findings" "$OUTDIR/docs" example-topic

The renderer reads the surviving findings directly (no separate synthesis step) and writes a full Diátaxis tree under docs/.
evals.expected_output: A complete Diátaxis documentation tree under docs/: a top-level index.md; a reference/ page per finding (grouped by dimension) plus reference/index.md; a per-dimension explanation/<dim>.md and how-to/apply-<dim>.md plus their indexes; and tutorials/getting-started.md, a per-dimension tutorials/<dim>.md, and tutorials/index.md. Every page carries MIF frontmatter that validates as a base concept (@context/@type/@id/conceptType/created plus diataxis_type) with no frontmatter title:, one body H1, and prose free of any internal-research identity (no finding or report urn:mif: ids, no extensions.harness or corpus paths, no finding handles).
